mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_message( message_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, session_id int NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT "system,user,assistant", content TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT "消息正文，图片语音则是COS的URL", msg_type VARCHAR(20) COMMENT "text,image,audio", parent_id BIGINT, tokens INT COMMENT "用于计费或控制上下文长度", create_time TIMESTAMP COMMENT "物理排序依据" );
mapper.select:
SELECT role,content FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND role != 'system' ORDER BY create_time
LIMIT #{num}
SELECT role,content FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND role = 'system'
